sourceText:
Shaking Beef
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:26pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 pounds of tender beef steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1/4 teaspoon sugar
1 teaspoon oyster sauce
2 teaspoons oil
3 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
1 medium onion, coarsely chopped
Lime Salt and Pepper

Preparation

1 Mix salt, pepper, sugar and oyster sauce. 2 Stir in steak cubes and marinate for 10 minutes 3 Heat oil in a frying pan until hot. 4 Stir-fry the garlic and onion until golden brown 5 Stir in steak cubes and continue to cook, shaking the frying pan occasionally, until steak is cooked to your taste

About


Excellent served with Lime Salt and Pepper sprinkled on top.
